characterization_methods.key_findings: CR70%: heavily elongated grains along RD with denser, darker slip bands (Figure 2d; 20 µm scale bar)
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Samples progressively ground and polished along RD, etched with hydrochloric acid (100 mL), alcohol (100 mL), copper chloride (5 g) etchant

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: JEM-2100 TEM (samples mechanically ground to 60 μm slices, punched into Φ3 mm disks, thinned with Gatan 691 ion milling)
characterization_methods.key_findings: CR70%: dislocation cells and dislocation walls delineating a cellular substructure (Figure 3d; 500 nm scale bar)

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: D8 ADVANCE X-ray diffractometer with Cu-Kα radiation (λ = 0.15406 nm)
characterization_methods.key_findings: CR70%: single-phase austenite with no martensite; FWHM(220) = 0.913°; microstrain = 6.2 × 10^-3; dislocation density = 12.9 × 10^14 m^-2
characterization_methods.purpose: Phase identification; quantify peak broadening, microstrain and dislocation density

characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Loading 500 g, dwelling time 15 s; average of at least 5 measurements

characterization_methods.key_findings: CR70%: UTS 1693 MPa, YS 1588 MPa, elongation 7.2%
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Strain rate 0.2 mm min^-1; temperature-controlled environment; dog-bone specimens (20 × 5 × 1 mm) machined along RD

characterization_methods.key_findings: CR70%: fine, dense, relatively shallow dimples with a more homogeneous appearance (Figure 9d; 10 µm scale bar)
characterization_methods.purpose: Examine fractured morphologies after tensile failure

analytical_models.equation_role: β = Kλ/(D cosθ) + 4ε tanθ; relates XRD peak broadening to grain size and microstrain, used to fit microstrain from peak broadening.
analytical_models.model_note: For CR70%, the (220) peak FWHM of 0.913° and fitted microstrain of 6.2 × 10^-3 were obtained.

analytical_models.equation_role: ρ = 2√3 (ε²)^(1/2) / (D b); calculates dislocation density from microstrain, grain size and Burgers vector.
analytical_models.model_note: Dislocation density for the CR70% sample calculated from average grain size and microstrain.

defect_interactions.interaction_type: dislocation-dislocation interactions forming dislocation walls and cells
defect_interactions.qualitative_or_quantitative_description: Larger dislocation cells form as dislocation density increases; dislocation walls emerge; the density of deformation twins decreases.

interfaces.phase_evolution: Single-phase austenite maintained; no deformation-induced martensitic transformation during CR.
interfaces.slip_behavior: Dislocation slip predominates as the primary deformation mechanism rather than deformation twinning at 70% CR reduction.

processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Prior to CR, all specimens underwent solution treatment at 1000 °C for 1 h and were then water-quenched to room temperature.

Specimens were immersed in liquid nitrogen for 3–5 min; after cooling, each specimen was rapidly removed for a single-pass rolling with ~2% thickness reduction, then promptly re-immersed; these steps were repeated until the cumulative thickness reduction reached 70%.

measurement_conditions.specimen_geometry: Dog-bone-shaped tensile specimens with standard distance segment of 20 × 5 × 1 mm, machined along RD

structures.overall_structure: Heavily elongated austenite grains along RD with dense slip bands; larger dislocation cells and dislocation walls form as dislocation density increases while twin density decreases; single-phase austenitic (FCC) structure maintained with no deformation-induced martensitic transformation.

unmapped_findings: The stacking fault energy (SFE) of this steel is 72 mJ m^-2 at room temperature and 51 mJ m^-2 at cryogenic temperature; the cryogenic SFE is still higher than the ~20–40 mJ m^-2 typically associated with twinning plasticity, but low-temperature dislocation restraint promotes deformation twinning at moderate CR strains before dislocation slip becomes predominant at 70% CR (b0044, b0047).
